<style>
/* FraWo GbR — v7.1 Emergency Text Fix — DEPLOYED 2026-05-16 11:00 */

@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap');

:root {
  --fw-bg: #0a0a0a;
  --fw-text: #ffffff;
  --fw-text-dim: #f5f5f5;
  --fw-text-dimmer: #cccccc;
  --fw-border: #1a1a1a;

  /* Main Brand Colors - Cyan Primary, Tundra Grey Accent */
  --fw-accent: #a050f0;           /* Main brand color (vivid #9D4EDD) */
  --fw-accent-light: #a050f0;     /* Lighter #9D4EDD for hover */
  --fw-accent-dark: #9d4edd;      /* Darker #9D4EDD for depth */
  --fw-tundra: #6b7067;           /* Tundra Grey (greenish-grey) */
  --fw-tundra-light: #8a8f87;     /* Lighter tundra */
  --fw-tundra-dark: #4a4d45;      /* Darker tundra */

  /* Professional spacing scale */
  --spacing-xs: 0.5rem;
  --spacing-sm: 1rem;
  --spacing-md: 2rem;
  --spacing-lg: 4rem;
  --spacing-xl: 6rem;
  --spacing-xxl: 8rem;

  /* Focus indicator */
  --focus-ring: 0 0 0 3px rgba(160, 80, 240, 0.4);
  --focus-offset: 2px;

  /* Typography scale */
  --text-xs: 0.75rem;
  --text-sm: 0.875rem;
  --text-base: 1rem;
  --text-lg: 1.125rem;
  --text-xl: 1.5rem;
  --text-2xl: 2rem;
}
  --text-3xl: 3rem;
}

/* Global */
body, #wrap, header, footer, .navbar {
  font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, sans-serif !important;
  background: var(--fw-bg) !important;
  color: var(--fw-text) !important;
}

h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6 {
  font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em !important;
}

/* ACCESSIBILITY - Focus Indicators (WCAG 2.1 AA) */
*:focus {
  outline: none;
}

*:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--fw-accent);
  outline-offset: var(--focus-offset);
  box-shadow: var(--focus-ring);
  transition: outline 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease;
}

a:focus-visible,
button:focus-visible,
.btn:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--fw-accent);
  outline-offset: var(--focus-offset);
  box-shadow: var(--focus-ring);
}

/* Skip to content link */
.skip-to-content {
  position: absolute;
  top: -100px;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  background: var(--fw-accent);
  color: #fff;
  padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem;
  border-radius: 0px !important;
  text-decoration: none;
  font-weight: 600;
  z-index: 9999;
  transition: top 0.2s ease;
}

.skip-to-content:focus {
  top: 1rem;
}

/* HEADER - ULTRA MINIMAL (NTS-Style) */
header#top, .o_header_standard, .o_header_affixed, .navbar, .navbar-light {
  background-color: transparent !important;  /* NO BACKGROUND */
  background: transparent !important;
  border-bottom: none !important;            /* NO BORDER */
  padding: 1.5rem 0 !important;             /* Generous spacing */
}

.navbar-brand {
  color: var(--fw-text) !important;
  font-weight: 400 !important;              /* Lighter weight */
  font-size: 0.95rem !important;           /* Smaller, subtle */
  text-transform: uppercase !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.15em !important;       /* Generous tracking */
}

/* Logo - Tiny, Subtle */
.navbar-brand img {
  height: 18px !important;                 /* Much smaller */
  width: auto !important;
  filter: none !important;
  mix-blend-mode: screen !important;
  opacity: 0.7 !important;
}

.navbar-brand img:hover {
  opacity: 1 !important;
}

/* Nav Items - Minimal, Lots of Breathing Room */
.nav-link, .navbar-light .navbar-nav .nav-link {
  color: var(--fw-text-dim) !important;
  font-weight: 400 !important;
  font-size: 0.85rem !important;
  text-transform: uppercase !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em !important;
  padding: 0.5rem 1.5rem !important;        /* Generous spacing */
  transition: color 0.15s ease !important;
}

.nav-link:hover {
  color: var(--fw-text) !important;
}

/* Footer - Hidden to remove Odoo placeholders */
footer, .o_footer {
  display: none !important;
}

/* Header - Hidden to create custom header */
header, .o_header {
  display: none !important;
}

/* Custom Header */
.fw-custom-header {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  width: 100%;
  background: rgba(10, 10, 15, 0.75);
  backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  z-index: 10000;
  padding: 1rem 0;
}

.fw-custom-header .container {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
}

.fw-nav a {
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7);
  text-decoration: none;
  margin-left: 2rem;
  font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif;
  font-weight: 500;
  transition: color 0.3s ease;
}

.fw-nav a:hover {
  color: #00ffff; /* neon-blue */
}

.fw-btn-header {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #8a2be2, #ff007f);
  color: white !important;
  padding: 0.5rem 1.5rem;
  border-radius: 50px;
  box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(138, 43, 226, 0.5);
  transition: transform 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease;
  white-space: nowrap !important;
}

.fw-btn-header:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: 0 0 25px rgba(138, 43, 226, 0.8);
}

@media (max-width: 576px) {
  .fw-nav a {
    margin-left: 1rem;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
  }
  .fw-btn-header {
    padding: 0.4rem 1rem !important;
    font-size: 0.9rem !important;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 400px) {
  .fw-nav a:not(.fw-btn-header) {
    display: none;
  }
}

/* Hero */
.fw-hero {
  min-height: 100vh;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  background: linear-gradient(rgba(10, 10, 10, 0.7), rgba(10, 10, 10, 0.9)), url('/web/image/1003/hero-bodensee.webp') no-repeat center center;
  background-size: cover;
  background-attachment: fixed; /* Parallax effect */
  padding-top: 100px !important;
  border-top: none;
}

.fw-hero .container {
  width: 100%;
}

.fw-eyebrow {
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: 0.15em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--fw-text-dimmer);
  margin-bottom: 2rem;
}
.fw-h1 {
  font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 3.5vw, 2.6rem);
  font-weight: 800;
  line-height: 1.1;
  color: var(--fw-text);
  margin-bottom: var(--spacing-md);
  letter-spacing: -0.03em;
  font-feature-settings: 'ss01' on, 'cv01' on;
}

.fw-lead {
  color: var(--fw-text-dim);
  font-size: clamp(1.125rem, 2vw, 1.25rem);
  line-height: 1.6;
  max-width: 42rem;
  margin-bottom: var(--spacing-lg);
  font-weight: 400;
}

/* Buttons - Minimal */
a.fw-btn-primary.btn {
  background: var(--fw-accent) !important;
  border: none !important;
  border-radius: 4px !important;
  padding: 14px 28px !important;
  font-weight: 600 !important;
  font-size: 0.85rem !important;
  color: #ffffff !important;
  text-transform: uppercase !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em !important;
  transition: background-color 0.2s ease !important;
  display: inline-block !important;
  text-decoration: none !important;
  white-space: nowrap !important;
}

a.fw-btn-primary.btn:hover {
  background: var(--fw-accent-light) !important;
}

a.fw-btn-ghost.btn {
  background: transparent !important;
  border: 2px solid var(--fw-accent) !important;
  border-radius: 4px !important;
  padding: 14px 28px !important;
  font-weight: 600 !important;
  font-size: 0.85rem !important;
  color: var(--fw-text) !important;
  text-transform: uppercase !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em !important;
  transition: all 0.2s ease !important;
  display: inline-block !important;
  text-decoration: none !important;
  white-space: nowrap !important;
}

a.fw-btn-ghost.btn:hover {
  border-color: var(--fw-accent-light) !important;
  color: var(--fw-accent-light) !important;
  background: rgba(157, 78, 237, 0.05) !important;
}

/* Split - NO BORDERS, Just Spacing */
.fw-split {
  padding: 100px 0;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--fw-border);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--fw-border);
}

.fw-split-pane {
  padding: 0;                              /* No padding, clean */
}

.fw-split-pane h2 {
  font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 3.5vw, 2.5rem);
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
  color: var(--fw-text);
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.2;
}

.fw-split-pane p {
  font-size: 1rem;
  color: var(--fw-text-dim);
  margin-bottom: 2rem;
  line-height: 1.6;
}

/* Grid - 1px Borders */
.fw-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 1px;
  background: #0a0a0a; /* Remove grey borders */
  border: 1px solid var(--fw-border);
}

@media (max-width: 992px) {
  .fw-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  }
}

@media (max-width: 576px) {
  .fw-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}

.fw-grid-item {
  background: var(--fw-bg);
  padding: 2.5rem;
}

.fw-grid-item h3 {
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
  color: var(--fw-text);
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
}

.fw-grid-item p, .fw-grid-item ul {
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  color: var(--fw-text-dim);
  line-height: 1.7;
}

.fw-grid-item ul {
  list-style: none;
  padding: 0;
  margin: 1rem 0 0 0;
}

.fw-grid-item ul li {
  padding: 0.35rem 0;
  padding-left: 1rem;
  position: relative;
}

.fw-grid-item ul li:before {
  content: "—";
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  color: var(--fw-text-dimmer);
}

/* Image - Professional kabaus.at style */
.fw-img-wrapper {
  overflow: hidden;
  background: #000;
  aspect-ratio: 16/10 !important; /* Square images */
  max-height: 450px !important;
  border-radius: 0px !important;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
  position: relative;
}

.fw-img-wrapper::after { display: none !important; }

.fw-img-wrapper picture {
  display: block;
  width: 100% !important;
  height: 100% !important;
}

.fw-img-wrapper img {
  width: 100% !important;
  height: 100% !important;
  object-fit: cover !important; /* Clever crop */
  object-position: center !important;
  display: block !important;
  transition: transform 0.3s ease;
}

.fw-img-wrapper:hover img {
  transform: scale(1.05);
}

/* Section */
.fw-section {
  padding: 100px 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--fw-border);
  background: var(--fw-bg) !important;
}

.fw-section-tight {
  padding: 60px 0;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--fw-border);
}

/* Remove all background conflicts */
body {
  background: var(--fw-bg) !important;
}

/* Container max-width for ultra-wide displays */
.container {
  max-width: 1400px !important;
  margin-left: auto !important;
  margin-right: auto !important;
}

@media (min-width: 1920px) {
  .container {
    max-width: 1600px !important;
  }
}

/* Sticky Radio Player */
.fw-radio-sticky {
  position: fixed;
  bottom: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  background: rgba(10, 10, 10, 0.9);
  backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--fw-border);
  z-index: 9999;
  padding: 12px 0;
}

.fw-radio-inner {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
}

.fw-radio-info {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 15px;
}

.fw-radio-visualizer {
  width: 20px;
  height: 20px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
  gap: 2px;
}

.fw-radio-bar {
  width: 3px;
  background: var(--fw-accent);
  animation: fw-bounce 0.8s ease-in-out infinite;
}

@keyframes fw-bounce {
  0%, 100% { height: 5px; }
  50% { height: 15px; }
}

.fw-radio-btn {
  background: transparent;
  border: 1px solid var(--fw-text-dimmer);
  color: var(--fw-text);
  width: 36px;
  height: 36px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
}

.fw-radio-btn:hover {
  border-color: var(--fw-text);
  color: var(--fw-accent);
}


/* ===== SECTIONS BASE ===== */
section {
  padding: 50px 0;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--fw-border);
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
  section {
    padding: 40px 0;
  }
}

/* Section Headers */
.fw-section-header {
  max-width: 800px;
  margin: 0 auto 40px;
  text-align: center;
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .fw-section-header {
    margin-bottom: 30px;
  }
}

/* ===== SERVICES GRID ===== */
.fw-services {
  background: transparent !important;
}

.fw-services .container {
  background: transparent !important;
}

.fw-services .row.g-4 {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  gap: 1.25rem;
  background: transparent !important;
  border: none;
  margin: 0;
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .fw-services .row.g-4 {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 1.5rem;
  }
}

.fw-services .col-lg-6 {
  padding: 0;
  max-width: none;
  flex: none;
}

.fw-h2 {
  font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 3.5vw, 2.5rem);
  font-weight: 700;
  line-height: 1.2;
  color: var(--fw-text);
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
}

.fw-h3 {
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  color: var(--fw-text);
  margin-bottom: 0.75rem !important;
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
}

.fw-service-card {
  background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.4);
  border-radius: 0px !important;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
  padding: 2rem 1.5rem !important;
  min-height: 320px !important;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  justify-content: flex-start;
  gap: 0.75rem !important;
}

.fw-service-card-bg {
  background-size: cover;
  background-position: center center;
  background-repeat: no-repeat;
  position: relative;
}

.fw-service-card-bg::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  background: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(10,10,10,0.75), rgba(10,10,10,0.95));
  z-index: 0;
}

.fw-service-card::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, transparent 0%, rgba(157, 78, 237, 0.05) 100%);
  opacity: 0;
  transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.fw-service-card:hover::before {
  opacity: 1;
}

.fw-service-card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-2px);
}

.fw-service-card-bg:hover {
  background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .fw-service-card {
    padding: 1.75rem 1.5rem;
    min-height: auto;
  }
}

.fw-service-icon {
  font-size: 2rem;
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
  opacity: 0.7;
}

.fw-service-desc {
  color: var(--fw-text-dim);
  font-size: 0.9375rem;
  line-height: 1.5;
  margin-bottom: 0.75rem !important;
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
}

.fw-service-list {
  list-style: none;
  padding: 0 !important;
  margin: 0 0 0.75rem 0 !important;
  flex-grow: 1;
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
}

.fw-service-list li {
  color: var(--fw-text-dim);
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  line-height: 1.5 !important;
  padding: 0.2rem 0 !important;
  padding-left: 1.25rem !important;
  position: relative;
  transition: color 0.2s ease;
}

.fw-service-list li:hover {
  color: var(--fw-text);
}

.fw-service-list li:before {
  content: "→";
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  color: var(--fw-accent);
  opacity: 0.5;
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  transition: opacity 0.2s ease;
}

.fw-service-list li:hover:before {
  opacity: 1;
}

.fw-service-link {
  color: var(--fw-text);
  font-size: 0.8125rem;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
  margin-top: auto;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
}

.fw-service-link:hover {
  color: var(--fw-accent);
  transform: translateX(4px);
}

/* ===== REFERENZEN GRID ===== */
.fw-referenzen {
  background: transparent !important;
}

.fw-referenzen .container {
  background: transparent !important;
}

.fw-referenzen .row.g-4 {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap: 1rem;
  background: transparent !important;
  border: none;
  margin: 0;
}

@media (max-width: 991px) {
  .fw-referenzen .row.g-4 {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
  }
}

@media (max-width: 576px) {
  .fw-referenzen .row.g-4 {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }
}

.fw-referenzen .col-lg-3,
.fw-referenzen .col-6 {
  padding: 0;
  max-width: none;
  flex: none;
}

.fw-ref-item {
  text-align: center;
  padding: 2rem 1.5rem;
  background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.3);
  border-radius: 0px !important;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
  transition: all 0.3s ease;
  min-height: 140px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  overflow: visible;
}

.fw-ref-item:hover {
  background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.5);
  border-color: var(--fw-accent);
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(157, 78, 237, 0.2);
}

.fw-ref-item strong {
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.03em;
  color: var(--fw-text);
  display: block;
  margin-bottom: 0;
  line-height: 1.3;
  word-break: break-word !important;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere !important;
  white-space: normal !important;
  max-width: 100%;
  overflow: visible !important;
  text-overflow: clip !important;
}

.fw-ref-item p {
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  color: var(--fw-text-dimmer);
  margin: 0;
  line-height: 1.4;
  word-break: keep-all;
  overflow-wrap: normal;
}

/* ===== PROJECTS SECTION ===== */
.fw-projects {
  background: transparent !important;
}

.fw-projects .container {
  background: transparent !important;
}

.fw-projects .row.g-1 {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 1rem;
  background: transparent !important;
  border: none;
  margin: 0;
  min-height: 350px;
}

@media (max-width: 991px) {
  .fw-projects .row.g-1 {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    min-height: auto;
    gap: 1.5rem;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .fw-project-card {
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
  }
}

.fw-projects .col-lg-4 {
  padding: 0;
  max-width: none;
  flex: none;
}

.fw-project-card {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  border-radius: 0px !important;
  aspect-ratio: 16/10;
  background: #000;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
  min-height: 280px;
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
  .fw-project-card {
    aspect-ratio: 16/10;
    min-height: 220px;
  }
}

.fw-project-card picture {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
}

.fw-project-card img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  object-position: center;
  transition: transform 0.3s ease;
  display: block;
}

.fw-project-card:hover img {
  transform: scale(1.05);
}

.fw-project-overlay {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(10,10,10,0.95), transparent);
  padding: 1.5rem 1.25rem;
  transform: translateY(100%);
  transition: transform 0.3s ease;
}

.fw-project-card:hover .fw-project-overlay {
  transform: translateY(0);
}

.fw-project-overlay h3 {
  margin-bottom: 0.35rem;
  font-size: 0.8125rem;
}

.fw-project-overlay p {
  color: var(--fw-text-dim);
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  margin: 0;
  line-height: 1.5;
}
